source.close_reason: Audited docs visibility across core and specialists; narrowed ignore rules, removed only internal/runtime paths from the indexes, and verified user-facing docs remain tracked.
source.description:
## PROBLEM
The core and specialists repositories contain documentation subdirectories that are currently visible on GitHub despite local ignore intent. Broad or missing ignore rules risk hiding user-facing examples, migration notes, and public operator documentation while failing to remove already-tracked internal documents.

## SUCCESS
Audit both repositories, keep user-facing documentation tracked, ignore only selected internal/archive/planning subdirectories, remove only those selected paths from the Git indexes without deleting working-tree files, and leave direct docs/* files and retained public subdirectories tracked.

## SCOPE
- /home/dawid/dev/core/.gitignore and selected tracked docs subdirectories.
- /home/dawid/dev/specialists/.gitignore and selected tracked docs subdirectories.
- Existing local changes must be preserved.

## NON_GOALS
- Do not delete documentation from working trees.
- Do not rewrite repository history.
- Do not alter document contents or user-facing README/roadmap edits.
- Do not push or open PRs as part of this task.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Use explicit subdirectory rules; never ignore all of docs/.
- Preserve direct docs/* files.
- Keep specialists examples, upgrade notes, operator docs, design/roadmap docs, and specialist handoff docs tracked unless audit evidence proves otherwise.
- Verify ignore behavior with git check-ignore --no-index and index membership with git ls-files.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Candidate subdirectories are evidence-classified as internal/archive/runtime or user-facing.
- [ ] No broad docs/ ignore rule remains.
- [ ] Only approved subdirectory paths are removed from the index; working-tree files remain.
- [ ] Direct docs/* files and retained user-facing subdirectories remain tracked.
- [ ] Git status/diff checks pass in both repositories.

## OUTPUT
Report the audit classification, exact ignore rules, retained user-facing surfaces, selected index removals, and verification results.
